pillars:
P1 durable work and failures: scheduled jobs, wakes, retries, failures the owner can see, exact-detail approvals.
P2: not defined in any source the readers found.
P3 memory: claims, recall, the context window, correction, forgetting.
P4 proactivity and triggers: day cards, event wakes, the delivery gate, active hours.
P5: not defined in any source the readers found.
P6 one agent on every surface: one brain and one state, rendered to each surface's ability.
P7 identity and consent: session, owner admission, consent, provider grants, rights.
P8 activity and observability: receipts, traces, evals, spend, latency.
Extra groups, named for their sources: Connector depth (ledger Wave 5), Health plane (ledger Wave 3, ADR-0081), Instinct parity (ledger §11), Operations and governance (plan §13, S0).
